overview_description.description:
NetBeez is a SaaS company that has developed a real-time, distributed, performance monitoring solution that detects network and application problems before users do. The platform monitors LAN, WAN, and WiFi networks from the user perspective, measuring and reporting KPI of service quality. NetBeez enables enterprise organizations to cut costs and reduce downtime by allowing IT to quickly detect, troubleshoot, and repair network issues.

The company helps enterprise organizations to cut costs and reduce downtime and time spent troubleshooting by allowing teams to quickly identify and fix network issues. NetBeez' agents simulate users' interaction with intranet/internet services delivering a view of the network previously unavailable.

It was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States.

product.name: Network Performance Monitoring
product.description: Runs continuous, end-to-end network tests from the end-user perspective to identify and resolve network infrastructure issues.

product.name: Remote Worker Network Monitoring
product.description: Collects network diagnostic data from remote employees' endpoints to troubleshoot ISP, Wi-Fi, VPN, and application performance issues.

product.name: Wi-Fi Monitoring and Assurance
product.description: Monitors Wi-Fi network performance from the client perspective to ensure reliable and secure wireless connectivity.

product.name: Hybrid Cloud Network Monitoring
product.description: Monitors network performance between private and public cloud environments to detect connectivity and performance issues.

product.name: SaaS and Application Performance
product.description: Monitors the end-user experience and performance of SaaS and on-premises applications to identify and resolve issues.
